name: kb_943_Normalized

schema.description: SecretReference represents a Secret Reference. It has enough information to retrieve secret in any namespace

name.description: Name is unique within a namespace to reference a secret resource.

namespace.description: Namespace defines the space within which the secret name must be unique.

description: Please configure the application to retrieve its database credentials from the secret reference called **db-credentials**. This secret resides in the **production** namespace, so the lookup must be scoped accordingly.
